title: astelma retorta
intro: Astelma retorta, commonly known as Devil's Claw, is a flowering plant native to southern Africa. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and pain, as well as alleviating symptoms of arthritis, anxiety, and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Astelma retorta are attributed to its ability to inhibit the production of pro-inflammatory enzymes, and its bioactive constituents include harpagoside, a iridoid glycoside responsible for its anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties. However, further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using Astelma retorta as a treatment for various health conditions.
